litigation.mdlName: In re: Cook Medical, Inc., IVC Filters Marketing, Sales Practices and Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Southern District of Indiana

phase: Active MDL; second Tulip bellwether pool in discovery
phaseDetail: JPML lists MDL-2570 as active before Senior Judge Richard L. Young. The July 14, 2026 Second Amended Case Management Order 34 sets fact discovery to close December 21, 2026 for three Günther Tulip bellwether candidates; the court is to select two for trial by May 26, 2027 and set trial dates at a June 2027 conference. No trial dates are set.

settlements.label: No MDL-wide settlement program or settlement track identified in reviewed records
settlements.detail: The Southern District of Indiana MDL-2570 page and case management order list, reviewed October 23, 2026, do not post a global settlement program, settlement track, mediation order, universal compensation matrix, or payment deadline. The July 14, 2026 Second Amended CMO 34 contains no settlement or mediation terms. An individual settlement or verdict does not set the value of another case.
settlements.individualClaims: No universal Cook IVC filter payment amount is verified here.
settlements.source: Southern District of Indiana MDL-2570 page

keyDates.label: MDL-2570 established
keyDates.detail: JPML centralized federal Cook IVC filter cases in the Southern District of Indiana before Judge Richard L. Young.

keyDates.label: Time-barred case screening order
keyDates.detail: Case Management Order 28 required plaintiffs' counsel to screen pending cases and dismiss claims barred by the statute of limitations or repose, and set a short-motion process for Cook to seek dismissal of others, following the court's earlier limitations and repose rulings.
keyDates.source: Southern District of Indiana, Case Management Order 28

keyDates.label: Second Tulip bellwether plan entered
keyDates.detail: Case Management Order 34 established a process for forming a pool of eligible Günther Tulip cases and selecting cases for trial dates.
keyDates.source: Southern District of Indiana, Case Management Order 34

keyDates.label: Second Amended Tulip bellwether schedule
keyDates.detail: Second Amended CMO 34 names three Günther Tulip bellwether candidates and sets fact discovery to close December 21, 2026 and expert discovery to close April 26, 2027.
keyDates.source: Southern District of Indiana, Second Amended Case Management Order 34

keyDates.label: 6,501 actions pending
keyDates.detail: JPML reports 6,501 pending actions and 11,478 historical actions in MDL-2570.

keyDates.label: Tulip bellwether fact discovery closes
keyDates.detail: Deadline under Second Amended CMO 34 for the three Günther Tulip bellwether candidates.
keyDates.source: Southern District of Indiana, Second Amended Case Management Order 34

keyDates.label: Court to select two Tulip cases for trial
keyDates.detail: Under Second Amended CMO 34, the court selects two of the three candidates for trial after expert discovery; trial dates are to be set at a June 2027 conference.
keyDates.source: Southern District of Indiana, Second Amended Case Management Order 34

updates.summary: The court's case management order list shows a July 14, 2026 Second Amended CMO 34: three Tulip bellwether candidates, fact discovery closing December 21, 2026, and the court selecting two for trial by May 26, 2027. Reviewed court pages post no settlement track or mediation order.
JPML reports 6,470 pending actions in MDL-2570 on October 1, 2026, down 31 from 6,501 on September 1; 11,478 total historical actions are reported separately.
The official MDL page continues to list MDL-2570 before Senior Judge Richard L. Young; reviewed public records do not announce an MDL-wide settlement program.
JPML reports 6,501 pending actions and 11,478 historical actions, compared with 6,537 pending and 11,474 historical actions on August 3.
The court entered a second Günther Tulip bellwether plan to form a pool and select cases for future trial dates.
